children: National Stock Exchange of India's (NSEI.NS) chief said on Friday that growth in its other businesses is likely to reduce the share of revenue generated by weekly options trading, as the country's largest bourse seeks a valuation of up to 4.42 trillion rupees ($46.26 billion) through its long-awaited IPO.
"Other businesses are also coming up to reduce pie of weekly options revenue," NSE MD and CEO Ashish Chauhan said during the firm's IPO press conference.
